profile.headline: Senior Project Engineer | Process Improvement | Workflow Transformation | Data & Automation Strategy
profile.summary: Over the course of my career, I found myself increasingly interested in how work gets done and how it can be improved. While I began in structural engineering, my interests naturally expanded into automation, software development, reporting, workflow design, and process improvement. Today I enjoy helping teams navigate complex problems, align stakeholders, and translate ideas into practical solutions.

positions.title: Structural Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead discovery efforts and stakeholder alignment across Engineering, Operations, Standards & Safety, IT, data teams, and external partners to define requirements and develop practical solutions.
• Serve as a trusted advisor on process improvement, workflow modernization, automation strategy, data architecture, solution alternatives, implementation risk, and adoption.
• Guide a portfolio of engineering-tool, workflow, reporting, data, and modernization initiatives while balancing operational needs, strategic roadmaps, and technical dependencies.
• Frequently serve as the first point of contact for teammates working through complex technical, operational, and process-related challenges requiring cross-functional coordination.
• Coach engineers and technical contributors through solution reviews, troubleshooting, project planning, presentation development, and knowledge sharing.
• Translate complex technical and operational issues into requirements, roadmaps, risk assessments, and decision-ready recommendations for leadership and partner teams.
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and support software solutions, workflow automation, reporting dashboards, and data-processing applications.
• Conduct requirements discovery, document business needs, develop quality assurance plans, and maintain software functionality throughout the solution lifecycle.
• Troubleshoot, enhance, and modernize existing applications, databases, reporting solutions, and data-processing workflows.
• Collaborate with internal customers, vendors, and business partners to resolve issues, improve processes, and support organizational objectives.
• Participate in cross-functional initiatives involving Structural Automation, SiteTracker modernization, Engineering Data, predictive analysis, data governance, and workflow transformation.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
• Led end-to-end delivery of internal software, workflow automation, reporting, and data-integration solutions from discovery through design, testing, deployment, support, and user feedback.
• Translated stakeholder needs into requirements, delivery plans, testing strategies, implementation controls, technical documentation, and support models.
• Coordinated internal customers, developers, data owners, and vendors to resolve defects, modernize legacy workflows, reduce process friction, and improve operational consistency.
• Developed and maintained applications, databases, reporting solutions, and quality controls supporting structural engineering and adjacent business processes.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Perform detailed structural analysis of original, modified, and proposed telecommunication towers.
• Assist in supporting engineering projects and studies.
• Perform detailed structural analysis of original, modified, and proposed telecommunication towers; monopole, lattice guyed, and lattice self-supporting structures and produce reports for review and
approval by an experienced engineer.
• Assist in the development of engineering processes and standards.
• Develop analysis assistance tools with MS Excel and MathCAD.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Inspect temperature of asphalt
•Extract AC content from asphalt
•Maintain a safe work environment
•Collaborate with contractor in order to maintain consistent readings

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
•Provide specialty lawn care. 
•Maintenance of lawn care equipment. 
•Meet with clients in order to review landscaping plans. 
•Oversee implementation of and shape projects. 
•Supervise workers who install and maintain landscape projects.

positions.title: Civil Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Supervise construction sites and maintained a steady work flow
•Responsible for organizing operations 
•Communicate with contractors and vendors
•Design solutions to fit operational needs
•Create timely schedules and report to project update meetings
•Collaborate with customers in order to keep the project to the highest standards of safety and operation
•Maintain a safe work environment
